command.attack.subtitle: All right. Let's make them work for it.
Fine by me. I was getting bored back here.
You want pressure? I'll give them pressure.
Moving in. Keep your head up.

command.regroup.subtitle: All right. Back on your wing.
Got their tail, but whatever you say, Kid.
Coming back to you. Don't wander off.
Rejoining. Try not to make me regret it.

command.attackTarget.subtitle: Tracking. I'll take it from here.
I see what you're looking at. Going after him.
Copy. I'll put pressure on your target.

command.defend.subtitle: Stay sharp. I'll watch the rest.
All right. I'll keep them off you.
You do your thing. I'll handle the pressure.
Covering. Don't make me chase you across the whole coast.
Fine. I'll babysit your six for a minute.

event.playerKill.subtitle: Heh. They picked the wrong pilot.
Keep that up and I'll start feeling unnecessary.

event.playerHit.subtitle: Took a hit, huh? Keep flying.
Careful. Don't give them another one.
I saw that. You still good?
Don't let them line up again.
Easy. You've still got the jet.
They clipped you. Make them pay for it.
Kid, don't get stubborn on me now.

event.playerDanger.subtitle: Get low, get fast, just move!
Break right! I'll try to peel him off!

event.wingmanHit.subtitle: Took a piece off me. Nothing important.
Don't worry about me. Watch your own six.

event.wingmanKill.subtitle: Thought he had me. He didn't.

event.wingmanMissile.subtitle: Let's see how he handles this.

event.combatStart.subtitle: All right, Kid. Here we go.
Heh. Quiet never lasts long out here.
Let's see what they brought this time.
Keep your spacing. I'll take the other side.

event.combatEnd.subtitle: We're clear. Let's not hang around.

ambient.standard.subtitle: Come on. Give me some fight.
Don't think you're getting away that easy.
They really keep sending these guys out here.
Kid, remind me who thought this coast was supposed to be quiet.
Heh. Another beautiful day at the end of the world.
They're flying like they already want to go home.
Don't chase too far. Let them come to us.
You take the loud one. I'll take the stupid one.
They've got numbers. We've got better habits.
I was promised a dangerous assignment. They're trying, I guess.
Keep them turning. I'll find the opening.
Not much of a welcome committee.
You know, Kid, I almost miss boring patrols.
Let's make this quick. I've had enough coastline for one day.

ambient.pressure.subtitle: Keep moving. They're trying to box us in.
Too many noses pointed our way.
Kid, don't give them a clean angle.
We've got pressure on both sides.
Stay loose. Don't let them set the pace.
All right. No more playing around.
They're better than the last group.
Keep your speed. This isn't the time to get greedy.
We're still ahead of them. Keep it that way.

ambient.calm.subtitle: Enjoy it, Kid. It never lasts.
Nice view. Shame about the people shooting at us.
You always fly this far out when you're bored?
Hard to believe anyone fights over places this empty.
Don't get comfortable. That's when something stupid happens.
Wind's calm. Radio's quiet. I don't trust it.
Not much out here but water, mountains, and bad decisions.
You know, Kid, silence used to bother me more.
Take the quiet while you can.
If command calls this 'routine,' I'm charging extra.
